messages:
marie: Quick sync — new SI intake: we're seeing more requests that touch marketplace listings + hardware bundling. need a clear lead flow and ownership rules so nobody duplicates outreach.
eden: +1. can we define by deal size / product scope? hardware bundles often need partner-ownedops.
samir: my take: split by net-new vs expansion. if it's an existing account with ARR > 250k, AE owns; if net-new and involves systems integration, SI gets lead. also: if marketplace paid co-sell is attached, prioritize partner route but notify AE.
joe_sales: what about co-sell crediting / influence? we need simple mapping so our SDRs don't ping both.
lina: propose simple matrix — columns: account_status (new/expansion), ARR_band (<50k, 50-250k, >250k), engagement_type (marketplace, hw_bundle, SI_impl). rows: owner -> {SI, AE, shared}.
marie: here's a quick example rule set to start with: ```
# lead_routing rules
if engagement_type == "hw_bundle" and partner_certified == true -> owner = SI
elif account_status == "expansion" and ARR > 250000 -> owner = AE
elif engagement_type == "marketplace" and partner_has_co_sell == true -> owner = partner (notify AE)
else -> owner = AE (notify partner)
```
eden: this looks good. add fallback: if SI capacity = 0 (partner flagged busy) -> AE auto-assigned. also require partner acknowledgement within 48h or escalates back to AE.
samir: agree on 48h SLA. also need a short intake form field: "expected infra scope" and "requires on-prem HW" so we can route to hardware partners quickly.
joe_sales: can we attach a tracking tag in the marketplace listing so marketplace leads auto-populate partner routing? e.g., marketplace_tag: "partner:acme-si"
lina: yes — we can bake that into the intake webhook. partner-bot: created routing webhook stub: /webhooks/partner-intake (dev only). payload must include: account_id, arr_estimate, engagement_type, marketplace_tag, partner_id.
marie: good. next: account mapping rules for territories — partners may request carveouts. we should require a minimal coverage doc (list of named accounts) before granting exclusivity. proposal: exclusivity for 90 days for named accounts only; otherwise shared.
eden: on joint announcements — timeline checklist: 1) partner legal ok (2 weeks) 2) joint customer quote approval 3) press release sync 4) marketplace listing update 5) joint webinar scheduling. assign PM to own the timeline.
jenna_pm: I'll own announcement timeline for any co-marketing. please add me on the intake if the pipeline stage == "marketing-ready".
samir: action items: lina to add tags to intake webhook (ETA 3 days), partner-bot to add 48h ack enforcement (ETA 5 days), jenna to draft 60-day announcement playbook template (ETA 7 days), marie to publish rules to Confluence and a one-page cheat sheet for SDRs (ETA 2 days).
marie: thanks. one last note: for hardware partners we should include a 'logistics owner' field in the intake (partner or internal ops). avoids confusion for deployment schedules.
eden: sounds actionable. I'll schedule a 30-min slot tomorrow to walk through the matrix and mock intake. who needs to be there? marie, lina, jenna_pm, samir, one rep from SI channel.
marie: ping @acme-si-sales to invite partner rep. thanks all. :thumbsup:
